text:
Ava (CS): Hey team — CrimsonPay's SIG/CAIQ bespoke is due tomorrow EOD. They asked specifically for (1) audit-log export covering last 90 days, (2) KMS key rotation evidence, and (3) HSM attestation. They say they can't close without artifacts.

OpsBot: :bell: Reminder — 24h until SIG evidence due for crimsonpay@crimsonpay.com

Mike (Solutions): I can prepare log samples and a repro export. Quick Q: do they want raw logs or redacted JSON? PII in these logs.

Ava (CS): They requested redacted samples + full export under NDA. Prefer CSV of auth events and a signed statement for KMS.

Sarah (Security): Notes:
- We cannot export HSM private material. Provide vendor attestation and HSM cert chain, plus export of HSM operation logs (audit events) only.
- For KMS rotation, provide CloudKMS/KeyVault rotation audit entries (rotation event, user, timestamp). We can generate a signed digest.

Tom (Eng-Ops): Repro steps for log export (internal playbook):
```
# export 90d auth logs (redacted)
./infra/tools/export-logs --service auth --start 2023-12-15 --end 2024-03-15 --redact pii --format csv --out crimsonpay_auth_90d.csv
# generate signed metadata
./infra/tools/sign-artifact --file crimsonpay_auth_90d.csv --key /kms/artifact-signing-key
```
I'll run this in staging and attach presigned link. Will need legal/nda signoff before giving full bucket.

Mike (Solutions): For KMS rotation evidence, we can pull CloudTrail events for kms:RotateKey and kms:UpdateKey. Sample query:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=RotateKey --start-time "2023-12-15" --end-time "2024-03-15" --max-results 50
```
Attach the relevant event IDs and a short explanation of who initiated and why.

Sarah (Security): Also include a short paragraph explaining retention policy mapping and where logs are stored (region + retention window). That helps SIG reviewers.

Ava (CS): Customer asked for timeline — can we commit to a partial deliverable (redacted samples + KMS rotation entries + HSM attestation) within 6 hours? Full export after NDA.

Tom (Eng-Ops): I can get redacted samples and KMS event list in ~3h. Need legal to confirm NDA path for the bucket link.

Mike (Solutions): I'll draft the HSM attestation template for Preston (vendor) to sign. ETA 2h.

Ava (CS): Great. I'll message the customer asking for NDA link and confirm they accept redacted sample first. If they push, escalate to Sarah.

OpsBot: :white_check_mark: Action created — ticket CS-4729 assigned to ava-cs, mike-solutions, tom-eng-ops. Due 1712000540.

Ava (CS): tagging @sarah-security for visibility in case reviewer needs to sign off.

Sarah (Security): I'll be on stand-by. If legal pushes for more detailed artifacts, we'll require DPA/NDA + IRL review.

Ava (CS): Thanks team — will update here with presigned link once Tom uploads.

Tom (Eng-Ops): Uploaded redacted CSV to staging bucket, presigned link expires in 72h: https://staging-s3.aws/redacted/crimsonpay_auth_90d.csv?presign=abc123

Ava (CS): Sent link to CrimsonPay and asked for NDA. CRM says they'll review now and confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:

Mike (Solutions): Drafted HSM attestation and sent to vendor Preston for signature.

Sarah (Security): Reviewed KMS event snippets — all rotation events present. I'll sign the short statement once Tom hands over final artifact.

Ava (CS): Closing loop in this thread once we have signed artifacts. Thanks everyone. :pray:
